mapper.select: SELECT u.user_class FROM users u JOIN wallets w ON u.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.wallet_id = #{walletId}

SELECT h.token_id, SUM(CASE WHEN w.wallet_id = #{walletId} THEN h.token_balance ELSE 0 END) as my_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN u.user_class = 'ENTERPRISE' THEN h.token_balance ELSE 0 END) as enterprise_total FROM kh_holdings.holdings h JOIN wallets w ON h.wallet_id = w.wallet_id JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY h.token_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.wallet_id = #{walletId} THEN h.token_balance ELSE 0 END) > 0
